AND i.i_status = CASE #{statusFilter} WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '대기중' WHEN 'COMPLETE' THEN '답변완료' ELSE #{statusFilter} END
AND (i.i_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR u.u_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries WHERE i_active = 1 AND i_status = '대기중'

SELECT i.i_idx, i.u_idx, i.i_category, i.i_title, i.i_status, i.i_answer, DATE_FORMAT(i.i_created, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS i_created, DATE_FORMAT(i.i_answered, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS i_answered, IFNULL(u.u_name, '알 수 없음') AS u_name FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN user u ON i.u_idx = u.u_idx WHERE i.i_active = 1
AND i.i_status = CASE #{statusFilter} WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '대기중' WHEN 'COMPLETE' THEN '답변완료' ELSE #{statusFilter} END
AND (i.i_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR u.u_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.i_status IN ('PENDING','대기중') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.i_idx DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
